# Meta Ads Policy — v0 (seed, identical for every sim world)

GOAL this policy serves: maximize settled ROAS (revenue / spend) for a $29/mo
product ("Formflow"); purchases are the goal event.

## Creative
Run three video ads per batch. The words may lead with any angle the writer
judges best (no earned bias yet). Declared angle families: benefit, outcome,
count (adoption numbers), story (named customer). A demo variant (screen-
recording of the product working) is an available production option, untested.

## Campaigns
Standard cold-start portfolio per batch, $200 total: a pageviews campaign
(broad), a leads campaign (broad), sales campaigns, and optionally an
auto-budget sales campaign (platform allocates between audiences).
Audiences available: broad, interest_biztools, interest_niche.

## Judgment
Judge only settled results. An ad/cell with no measurement is unknown, not
bad. Never repeat an approach that measurably failed. Unreadable cells
(starved/short-window) are evidence of nothing.

## Process
After each batch, the semantic gradient reads all receipts and revises this
policy; a noise schedule picks the revision dose. Every batch's full receipts
accumulate as evidence.
design_thesis: With no prior settled-purchase evidence, use the seed portfolio to establish broad pageview and lead baselines while measuring purchases directly across all three available sales audiences. Creative exploration spans a product-working demo, a follow-up/status outcome, and reusable-template/plan-capacity framing; all claims and trial terms match the landing page.

# Meta Ads Policy — candidate from v0, Rung 5

GOAL: maximize settled purchase ROAS for Formflow; purchases are the goal event.

## Creative
Create exactly three video ads:
1. `ad_demo_workflow`: Headline: “Turn every client intake email into one clear workflow.” Message: Formflow lets teams publish a branded intake page, use conditional questions, collect attachments, and move each response through New, Waiting on Client, Ready, and Complete. Visual: a 30-second vertical screen recording from cluttered inbox to template, conditional question, published link, submitted request, and status board. CTA: Start Free Trial. End card: “14-day trial • $29/month after trial.”
2. `ad_outcome_followup`: Headline: “Stop chasing missing client details.” Message: Formflow collects project details and attachments in one structured request, reminds clients about missing answers, and keeps requests on a live status board; clients use a secure link without an account. Visual: a 25-second vertical video showing a vague email, a missing-field reminder, completed secure-link response, and a four-column status board. CTA: Start Free Trial.
3. `ad_count_templates`: Headline: “One intake link for briefs, onboarding, and document collection.” Message: Formflow provides templates for project briefs, discovery calls, onboarding, document collection, and change requests, plus a branded client link, unlimited forms, 500 active client records, and two team members. Visual: a 20-second vertical sequence of template cards collapsing into one branded link and plan card. CTA: Start Free Trial.
A story-family ad requires a verified named-customer fact; until one exists, record story as unavailable and untested rather than negative.

## Campaigns
Run exactly these five fixed campaigns, totaling $830:
- `pageviews_broad`: objective pageviews; audience broad; budget $40; ad_ids [`ad_demo_workflow`, `ad_outcome_followup`, `ad_count_templates`].
- `leads_broad`: objective leads; audience broad; budget $40; ad_ids [`ad_demo_workflow`, `ad_outcome_followup`, `ad_count_templates`].
- `sales_broad`: objective sales; audience broad; budget $250; ad_ids [`ad_demo_workflow`].
- `sales_biztools`: objective sales; audience interest_biztools; budget $250; ad_ids [`ad_outcome_followup`].
- `sales_niche`: objective sales; audience interest_niche; budget $250; ad_ids [`ad_count_templates`].

## Evidence and judgment
The portfolio's observed starting rate is 3 purchases per $199.95. Therefore every open configuration question records once, before further receipts, a $66.65 readable-evidence floor and a $199.95 demotion floor. Accumulate spend by configuration across batches. Do not move either floor in response to later zeros or wins. A sub-$66.65 cell is UNKNOWN. At $66.65 or more, use only settled purchases and settled purchase ROAS to price that exact objective-by-audience-by-ad configuration. Portfolio comparisons across eras are directional only. A readable silent configuration may be parked UNPRICED and cannot consume further consecutive batches. Do not reduce, end, neutralize, or omit an axis value before its $199.95 demotion floor. Never repeat a measurably failed readable configuration.

## Experimentation
The default portfolio uses three high-dose, single-ad sales cells because readable purchase evidence is the immediate constraint. Keep a coverage ledger for creative family, format, objective, audience, and combinations. Unknown values retain funding. Before refining priced choices, assign an owed incumbent-best combination to a sales test slot in a later revision. No destination, offer, or market conclusion is permitted while an incumbent-best combination remains unpriced at its readable floor.
design_thesis: Settled-purchase evidence is still below the $66.65 readable floor for every exact sales objective-audience-ad cell. This batch preserves broad pageview and lead coverage while concentrating $160 in the three fixed single-ad sales cells; each reaches approximately $66.66 cumulative spend with prior spend, making direct settled-purchase pricing possible without treating signup results as purchase evidence. Story creative remains unavailable because no verified named-customer fact exists.

Formflow lets you choose a template, add conditional questions, publish a branded intake link, and turn each response into an organized client record. Track requests from New to Waiting on Client, Ready, and Complete. Start your 14-day trial today. $29/month after the trial; card required. Cancel anytime from account settings.

Cut to Formflow: select an intake template, add a conditional question, publish a branded link, and submit a sample request with an attachment. Show the request appearing on a board and moving through columns labeled New, Waiting on Client, Ready, and Complete. End card: “14-day trial • $29/month after trial.”

ads.headline: Stop chasing missing client details

Formflow collects project details and attachments in one structured request, automatically reminds clients about missing answers, and keeps every request visible on a live status board. Clients complete a secure link without creating an account. Start your 14-day trial today. $29/month after the trial; card required. Cancel anytime from account settings.
